envelope.reason: purview guard denied three routing messages

payload.title: purview guard reads a message to an agent as an artifact write
payload.body: With the judge answering again after loop-friction, the purview guard denies the architect's write to agent://<name> (a message routing a unit name to a warm assayer, or a whole report to the planner) as a write whose codomain is artifact. A message to an agent is a route, inside writes⟨C · note · route⟩; the guard reads the write tool by its name, not its target. Workaround: route through a fresh dispatch, which it passes, at the cost of losing warm agents' context. The purview rubric should classify a write to agent:// as a route.
